name: GHIBLI
about: The valley hand-painted: the same world, places and roads as hooks/world.js, drawn as a painting. build.mjs bundles the first art file here that exists.

art.about: The painted valley: the whole 768×432 world (any size in that shape), no text, labels or interface painted in.
A local stand-in (git-ignored): the design mockup, whose map fills its top 660 rows; its painted-in labels and title show through.
